title: T21-S: independent geometry and excitation -- does the post-hoc spike/loadings explanation predict per-direction recovery?
status: configured (local build; nothing executed; no outcome exists)
question: On an independent synthetic geometry (planted unit directions in whitened R^d with an orthogonal and a correlated Gram, Gaussian spiked signal covariance, identity noise, two aspect ratios gamma = d/N), does the frozen isolated-spike-times-loadings predictor reproduce the rank-k PCA recovery of each planted direction, and does unique-component recovery separate a direction's own excitation from its overlap with other excited directions?
hypotheses: H1 (predictor, primary): for every confirmation configuration and direction classified 'primary' (no population spike carrying >= 0.05 of the direction lies in the BBP band 0.7 <= theta/sqrt(gamma) <= 1.8), the seed-mean ordinary recovery ||P u_j||^2/||u_j||^2 lies within 0.05 (absolute) of the frozen prediction sum_i loading^2(j,i) c^2(theta_i, gamma), in BOTH geometry arms and BOTH aspect ratios.

H1' (near-edge, secondary): configurations/directions classified 'near_edge' agree within 0.10 (finite-d corrections of the asymptotic overlap formula are largest at the transition; reported, not decisive).

H2 (overlap confound made explicit): in the correlated arm with the varied direction at theta_j = 0, ordinary recovery of u_j is predicted and observed well above chance while unique-component recovery of u_j^perp is at chance; in the orthogonal arm the two recoveries coincide identically.
H0 (all-zero control): with K = 0 the mean recovery equals the chance level k/d within z = 5 standard errors of the exact Beta(k/2,(d-k)/2) law (a pipeline check, not a scientific hypothesis).
independent_unit: one seed = one independent training draw (N x J latent Gaussians and N x d noise Gaussians). Uncertainty for every reported mean is computed across seeds within a configuration, never across the coordinates or directions of one draw. Seeds are shared across configurations (the same seed gives the same underlying draw for every configuration with the same N and d), so contrasts between configurations are paired; no across-configuration independence is claimed.

estimands.recovery: ||P u_j||^2 / ||u_j||^2 for the rank-k PCA projector P fitted on centred training data in whitened coordinates (noise covariance I, so whitening is the identity map); dimensionless in [0, 1]
estimands.unique_recovery: ||P u_j^perp||^2 / ||u_j^perp||^2 with u_j^perp = u_j projected off span{u_i : i != j}; undefined (null, flag unique_defined=false) when ||u_j^perp||^2/||u_j||^2 < 1e-3
estimands.predicted_recovery: sum_i loading^2(j,i) c^2(theta_i, gamma) with c^2 = (1 - gamma/theta^2)/(1 + gamma/theta) for theta > sqrt(gamma) else 0, theta_i the excess population eigenvalues of the exact K, loading(j,i) = u_j . v_i; the same expression on the normalised u_j^perp gives predicted_unique_recovery
estimands.abs_error_of_mean: |seed-mean recovery - predicted_recovery| per (configuration, direction); the scored quantity
estimands.chance_level: k/d, the expectation of recovery for a Haar-random rank-k projector
estimands.population quantities: theta, theta/sqrt(gamma), population excess eigenvalues of the exact K, c^2 per spike, loadings^2 -- all computed from the exact K, never from data

controls: all_zero: K = 0 (pure noise) per geometry x aspect ratio; recovery must be at chance k/d in expectation (checked; refusal exit 4 if violated)
all_strong: every direction at theta = 3 sqrt(gamma) per geometry x aspect ratio (reference configuration; descriptive)
orthogonal geometry: unique-component recovery must equal ordinary recovery identically (checked per cell to 1e-9)
correlated geometry: ordinary and unique-component recovery are different observables (difference reported, not scored)

geometry invariants (algebraic cells): realised Gram equals the declared Gram to 1e-10, unit norms, frame orthonormality, Schur identity for unique norms, exact K spectrum equals the spectrum of diag(sqrt theta) G diag(sqrt theta)
predictor sanity (algebraic cell): c^2 = 0 at and below sqrt(gamma), monotone above, tends to 1 as theta -> infinity, never outside [0, 1]

design.gamma_note: gamma = d/N: 'hi' arm gamma = 2 (> 1), 'lo' arm gamma = 0.25 (< 1)
design.learner: rank-k closed-form PCA (SVD of the centred N x d training matrix, top-k right singular vectors); one fit per cell

geometry.construction: Q = QR(Gaussian d x J, seed frame_seed, diag(R) > 0); U = Q L^T with G = L L^T (Cholesky); K = U diag(theta) U^T; noise N(0, I)
geometry.independence_from_archive: no pulse family, no channel/temporal bases, no Jacobian columns, no AR(1)/Brownian covariance; the archived Gram (-0.652, 0.594, -0.368, -0.315) and spectrum (39.6, 15.1, 2.11, 0.54) are not reproduced

grid.rule: one direction varied at theta_j = ratio * sqrt(gamma), the other three held at theta = strong_ratio * sqrt(gamma); strong_ratio = 3 is not a grid point so no grid cell duplicates the all_strong control

seeds.note: inclusive ranges; 4 pilot seeds and 20 confirmation seeds per configuration; namespaces above are reservations, these are the allocations

predictor.source: successor report 2026-09-12 (MS reviews/2026-09-12-T19-T22-SUCCESSOR-REPORT.md, T21-S): Donoho-Gavish-Johnstone 2018 eq. 1.6 with loadings; fixed before this package existed; no coefficient is fitted on any data
predictor.frozen_before_confirmation: the pilot reducer writes FROZEN_PREDICTOR.json (formula id, tolerance, every confirmation configuration's data-free predictions and cell ids) into the run root; confirmation cells refuse to run (exit 6, nothing charged) without it

tolerance.classification: data-free, per (configuration, direction): 'near_edge' when some population spike with loading^2(j,i) >= 0.05 has 0.7 <= theta_i/sqrt(gamma) <= 1.8, else 'primary'

predictor.scoring_rule: per (configuration, direction): pass iff |seed-mean observed - frozen predicted| <= tolerance for its class; H1 holds for a geometry arm iff every primary (configuration, direction) in that arm passes (an all-of rule: more scored pairs make a pass harder, never easier; no p-values are computed); near-edge and unique-component agreement are reported with the same tolerances as secondary; the bootstrap CI of the seed mean is descriptive
predictor.chance_floor_note: the predictor ignores the chance floor k/d = 0.0156 (production), which is inside the primary tolerance; no chance-corrected variant is scored

pilot_regime_rule.purpose: check only that the grid populates the below / near / above-threshold regimes on pilot seeds; pilot outcomes are never scored against the predictor
pilot_regime_rule.below_statistic: mean over pilot seeds and varied directions of the varied direction's unique-component recovery
pilot_regime_rule.above_statistic: mean over pilot seeds and varied directions of the varied direction's ordinary recovery
pilot_regime_rule.evaluated_per: geometry x aspect ratio; all four arms must populate
pilot_regime_rule.if_not_populated: FROZEN_PREDICTOR.json records confirmation_permitted=false; confirmation is refused; a changed grid is a new protocol version (v3) with provenance to this one

all_zero.law: recovery of a fixed unit direction under a Haar-random rank-k projector is Beta(k/2,(d-k)/2): mean k/d, var 2k(d-k)/(d^2 (d+2)); tolerance = z * sd / sqrt(n_seeds) on the per-seed direction-mean, the direction average not credited

fixture.note: development namespace only; full grid, 2 seeds per phase; outputs are marked development_only and are never citable; the chance level 4/24 = 0.167 exceeds the primary tolerance, so fixture agreement numbers mean nothing

inference.rule: deterministic tolerance rule on seed means (design.predictor.scoring_rule); uncertainty across independent seeds within a configuration (sd, se, fixed-seed percentile bootstrap CI of the mean, 1000 replicates, seed derived from the configuration key); no hypothesis tests, no p-values
inference.multiplicity: the verdict per geometry arm is an all-of over its primary (configuration, direction) pairs; adding pairs cannot manufacture a pass; the number of scored pairs is reported
inference.replicates: bootstrap replicates are reported as 'replicates', never as fits

stopping_rule: fixed allocation: 104 configurations x 4 pilot seeds (416 fits) + 104 configurations x 20 confirmation seeds (2080 fits) + 3 algebraic cells (0 fits, 2 solves); every cell is run and reduced; no early stop, no sequential decision, no outcome-dependent extension

failure_interpretation.predictor_fails_on_correlated: if H1 fails in the correlated arm the post-hoc spike/loadings explanation of the archived T21 outcome is NOT supported; the archived verdicts (5/5 predictions not met) are unchanged either way
failure_interpretation.predictor_fails_on_orthogonal_only: if H1 fails in the orthogonal arm the isolated-spike overlap itself does not describe this learner at these sizes; the loadings step is then untested
failure_interpretation.predictor_passes: if H1 passes in both arms the explanation is supported on synthetic Gaussian spiked data with identity noise only; nothing follows for the pulse family, for real detectors, or for any universal detection edge or abstention threshold
failure_interpretation.near_edge_disagreement: disagreement confined to near-edge pairs is reported as the expected finite-d limitation of an asymptotic formula, not as support and not as refutation
failure_interpretation.all_zero_control_fails: pipeline error: the run is refused at reduce (exit 4); nothing scientific is concluded
failure_interpretation.regimes_not_populated: design error found at pilot: confirmation is refused; the grid is revised in a new protocol version

budget.fit_definition: one fit = one rank-k PCA on one drawn training matrix; one solve = the eigen-decomposition of the exact K per data cell plus one per geometry-invariant algebraic cell (counted, costed, not capped)
budget.fixture_to_production_scale_note: ratio of the dominant flop counts N d min(N,d): production (128,256) or (1024,256) over fixture (12,24) or (96,24) = 10.67^3 = 1214 for both aspect ratios; fixture cells are overhead-dominated so this is an upper bound
budget.retry_policy: one retry per failed cell, charged; a second failure of the same cell stops the run for inspection; headroom under the cap = 254 fits (10.2% of the plan); failures, retries and interrupts are never refunded

explicitly_not_claimed: any repair of the five unmet registered T21 predictions (they remain NOT met; see FINDINGS_T21S.md)
any statement about the archived pulse family, its Jacobian directions or its Gram/spectrum
a universal detection edge in theta/sqrt(gamma) (c^2 depends on theta and gamma separately) or any abstention threshold
recoverability or non-recoverability of physical latents in any real detector
validity of the predictor beyond Gaussian spiked data with identity noise, rank-k PCA and k = J

provenance.prior_protocol: none: no T21-S protocol was written on 12 September 2026 (successor report: 'frozen protocol: none written'; 0 of 320 allocated fits; seeds 5000-5079 / 6000-6239 reserved and unused). This v2 file is the first T21-S protocol; 'v2' marks that it follows the archived T21 design (v1 = experiments/paper1/t21_excitation.py, immutable).

design_inputs_from_archive.predictor: c^2(theta,gamma) = (1 - gamma/theta^2)/(1 + gamma/theta) for theta > sqrt(gamma) else 0 (DGJ eq. 1.6); predicted recovery sum_i loading^2(j,i) c^2(theta_i,gamma); frozen, no coefficient fitted on confirmation
design_inputs_from_archive.historical_geometry_to_differ_from: planted pulse family at alpha=0, C=8, T=256 (d=2048), four latents (amplitude, rise, decay, secondary), Gram <amp,decay> = -0.652, <rise,decay> = 0.594, <amp,rise> = -0.368, <decay,secondary> = -0.315; population excess eigenvalues 39.6, 15.1, 2.11, 0.54; N in {800, 3200}
design_lessons: the archive had no all-zero cell (only all-at-0.1): a genuine all-zero control is included here
grid on eigen-spike strength relative to sqrt(gamma), not on an excitation ratio (s in {0.03, 0.1} were near-replicas of s = 0 because induced variance is proportional to s^2)
the s = 0 probe returning the prior is a constant-target artefact: no probe is used here
theta/sqrt(gamma) alone does not fix c^2: no universal detection edge and no abstention threshold is claimed
design_inputs_from_archive.historical_verdicts: all five registered T21 predictions remain NOT met; this package cannot repair them
